thread:
Marta: Noticing a regression after the last ingress push — hosted streaming P95 up ~12% in NA canaries. CPU on hosts spiked and traces show tokenization + parse overhead dominating. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/boards/ingress-p95
Dmitri: Is this localized or global? Any inbound framer/coalesce changes in that deploy?
Marta: Only changes were the new framer (slimframe) that avoids copies for large frames and a tweak to small-write coalescing thresholds. Affected only canary + 2 NA zones so far. KV cache miss rate up ~6-9% on those hosts.
Sai: Can you paste the pprof top lines from a hot instance? Even a short profile helps.
Marta: pprof (cpu, 30s):
```
pprof top
12.4% host_tokenize::tokenize_stream
9.1% ingress::parse_partial_frame
8.0% grpc::writev_small_batch
4.9% kvcache::lookup_miss_accounting
3.8% allocator::slab_alloc
```
Marta: Notably we're seeing repeated tokenize calls for many tiny streaming chunks (50-200B).
Dmitri: That fits. Slimframe reduces copy for big frames but increases fragmentation for TCP/HTTP/gRPC streaming — partial frames get handed to tokenizer more often, so prefix reuse/KV lookup doesn't hit.
Eve: Two-fold problem: (1) more tokenize work on host CPU; (2) more KV misses because prefixes are chopped. That explains CPU and P95.
Sai: Quick mitigations: increase ingress read-buffer (eg 256->2048), fall back to legacy coalescer for streaming endpoints, or add a tokenizer micro-cache to accumulate partial prefixes until a delimiter. Which is fastest to test?
Marta: I spun up one canary with read-buffer=2048 and rolled slimframe=false there. Results T+15m: host P95 down ~7%, KV miss back to baseline, CPU down ~9%. No downstream errors in traces.
Dmitri: Also check kernel-selection changes at runtime 111 if batch sizes dropped the runtime may pick a single-token kernel causing poorer GPU throughput. Capture kernel selection histogram across the canary window.
Marta: Early kernel picks show a shift: +18% single-batch kernels for sequences <8 tokens. I'll dump histograms to the perf bucket.
BuildBot: @deploy-bot rolled back ingress slimframe flag on canary (job 2056012412) :white_check_mark:
Eve: Action items: Marta run 1h A/B with buffer bump and legacy coalesce; Dmitri add kernel-selection + kv-reuse telemetry per request; Sai prototype tokenizer micro-prefetch (hold prefixes for 1-2 frames).
Marta: A/B started. Uploading flamegraphs + pprof to incident board as I get them.
Dmitri: If A/B stays stable, we should roll the buffer bump and keep slimframe disabled for streaming routes, and add a perf regression test simulating lots of 1-8 token streaming sessions in CI. Also consider tuning slimframe's small-write threshold.
Eve: Agree. Add an automated nightly microbench covering streaming short-token tails.
Marta: Update T+30m: canary P95 trending baseline, CPU trending down. Leaving A/B for the hour. Will attach full traces when A/B completes.
Dmitri: Thanks 1 keep notes and artifacts here for postmortem.
Marta: Will do. Closing this thread once A/B finishes.
